messages.subject: Access legend data?
parts:
I'm trying to write a "translator" from ggplot2 to d3, and I'd like to be able to access the legend entries from a ggplot2 plot.

For say 

library(plyr) # to access round_any
movies$decade <- round_any(movies$year, 10)
m <- ggplot(movies, aes(x=rating, colour=decade, group=decade)) + 
  geom_density(fill=NA) + scale_colour_continuous(guide="legend") 

for instance, it would be ideal to be able to get a table of 

1900  | #000000
1925  | #111111
1950  | #222222
1975  | #333333
2000  | #444444

showing the color and the label it maps to. 

I've managed to get the grob for the guide, but I can't seem to successfully pull that data out. Is there an easier way to do this? I'd like to pull it out of the ggplot2 object, since that would enable me to match everything as closely as possible. 

Thanks!

Working from the grob is probably too low level; you would be better
working from the results of ggplot_build. Then you will have all the
scale training done, but still in a structured form.

For this case, the following code will get the info:

mb <- ggplot_build(m)
sc <- mb$plot$scales$scales[[1]]
bk <- ggplot2:::scale_breaks(sc)
val <- ggplot2:::scale_map(sc, bk)
labels <- ggplot2:::scale_labels(sc)
data.frame(bk, val, labels)

Note that this is calling un-exported functions, so it is not guaranteed
stable. I got most of this by looking at guide_train.legend.
Also note that I had to look at mb$plot$scales$scales to see which one
was the colour scale; it is not necessarily the first one.
